summary: Tested BIDZONE ADMIN FLOW (frontend-only) per review_request. Verified silent-redirect guards on /admin for both anonymous and authenticated non-admin users, absence of profile-admin-link on /profile for non-admins, and graceful fallback of the AuthContext profile query when the is_admin column is missing from the Supabase profiles table (migration 20260701000002 not yet applied). All 4 scenarios PASS.

tests_executed.name: Anonymous visits /admin
tests_executed.details: Final URL redirected to '/', no [data-testid=page-admin] in DOM, no [data-testid=admin-title] in DOM.

tests_executed.name: Non-admin authenticated user (sellera@bztest.dev) visits /admin
tests_executed.details: Signed in via Supabase password grant (user id aa000000-...-a1), reloaded, then navigated to /admin. useEffect guard fired after profile loaded; URL redirected to '/', page-admin and admin-title never mounted. page-admin-loading was also cleaned up (component fully unmounted post-redirect).

tests_executed.name: /profile hides profile-admin-link for non-admin
tests_executed.details: Profile page rendered for sellera@bztest.dev with profile-title and correct email. [data-testid=profile-admin-link] absent from DOM (profile.is_admin is falsy).

tests_executed.name: AuthContext fallback when is_admin column missing
tests_executed.details: Two Supabase REST 400 responses observed on initial profile query (is_admin column missing in live DB — expected, migration not yet applied). Fallback query executed, Profile page loaded fully with email/display name, no unhandled JS errors, no admin-related console errors, no pageerror events.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard useEffect guard is correct: waits for isLoading to be false and only redirects when profile has resolved (profile !== null && !isAdmin) — prevents flashing redirect for admins during profile fetch.
AuthContext fallback logic in profileQuery correctly re-queries without is_admin on schema errors and defaults is_admin=false. Confirmed working live against a Supabase where the column is absent.
Profile page only renders profile-admin-link when profile?.is_admin is truthy — admin surface is fully invisible to normal users as intended.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md Seller A (sellera@bztest.dev / BzTest-A-2026!) via Supabase password grant to simulate a non-admin authenticated user.
seed_data_creation: None. No data created; only session token installed in localStorage for the browser test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin visibility/redirect guards are verified frontend-side. To validate the positive path (admin sees page-admin), the migration 20260701000002_bidzone_admin_role.sql must be applied to live Supabase and a test user's profiles.is_admin flipped to true. That verification is DB-gated and out of scope until the user applies the migration. Sign-in trick for future tests: POST to https://ialusnghydghsykekgeb.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with the anon apikey, then write the token JSON into localStorage['sb-ialusnghydghsykekgeb-auth-token'] and reload.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Guard logic and fallback both behave exactly as specified.
